description: Comprehensive 38-district travel intelligence system for Tamil Nadu. Spanning ancient Dravidian temple gopurams, misty Western Ghat hill sanctuaries, UNESCO Chola monoliths, royal Chettinad culinary merchant estates, vibrant Kongu heartlands, and sacred oceanic capes.

ghat_corridors.scenic_note: Mountain ascent via Mettupalayam-Coonoor pass with 36 hairpin bends and tea estate mist (~26 km/h + 25m mountain safety buffer).

ghat_corridors.corridor_name: Batlagundu - Palani Ghat Road to Kodaikanal (SH 156)
ghat_corridors.scenic_note: Ascent through Palani Ghat Road with misty valley overlooks and pine scent (~28 km/h + 20m mountain buffer).
Winding 20-hairpin climb to Shevaroy hills with panoramic views of Salem city basin (~28 km/h).
Thrilling 70-hairpin bend climb through dense forest to the Kolli hill range (~24 km/h + 30m buffer).
Remote mountain ghat through cardamom and tea plantations to Highwavys Cloud Mountain (~24 km/h).
Scenic coastal highway crossing the historic Pamban Sea Bridge to Rameswaram Island (~60 km/h).
Smooth 4-lane highway across fertile Cauvery delta fields connecting UNESCO living Chola monuments (~65 km/h).

chennai.name: Chennai
chennai.description: Tamil Nadu's bustling cultural and coastal capital, celebrated for heritage Dravidian temples, colonial British architecture, Carnatic music sabhas, and vibrant Marina shoreline.

pois.name: Kapaleeshwarar Temple, Mylapore
pois.description: 7th-century CE Shaivite temple built in Dravidian style with a 37-meter rainbow gopuram, holy Kapaleeshwarar tank, and peacocks dedicated to Goddess Karpagambal.

pois.name: Marina Beach & Lighthouse, Chennai
pois.description: One of the longest natural urban beaches in the world (13 km), featuring an elevator-accessible maritime lighthouse overlooking the Bay of Bengal and animated beachside sundal stalls.

pois.name: Fort St. George & Clive Museum
pois.description: First British fortress in India founded in 1644, housing St. Mary's Church and Clive Museum displaying period arms, medals, and silver coins.

hotels.name: Marina Grand Heritage Inn, Chennai
hotels.description: Comfortable stay located minutes from Mylapore temple and Marina promenade.

food_places.name: Ratna Cafe Triplicane Since 1948
food_places.description: An undisputed Chennai culinary landmark famous for waiters pouring piping hot aromatic sambar from stainless steel jugs over cloud-like idlis.

chengalpattu.name: Chengalpattu
chengalpattu.description: Gateway to the UNESCO World Heritage monuments of Mamallapuram, rocky monolithic cave temples, pristine East Coast Road beaches, and tranquil Vedanthangal wetlands.

pois.name: Shore Temple & Pancha Rathas, Mahabalipuram
pois.description: 8th-century structural granite temple standing right against the Bay of Bengal surf, alongside monolithic five rathas carved from single boulders by King Narasimhavarman I.

pois.name: Vedanthangal Bird Sanctuary
pois.description: India's oldest water bird sanctuary (est. 1798), hosting over 40,000 migratory waterfowl including painted storks, spoonbills, and grey pelicans nesting on Barringtonia trees.

hotels.name: Mahabalipuram Sea Breeze Resort
hotels.description: Laidback coastal stay offering immediate access to the beach and shore temple views.

food_places.name: Moonrakers Coastal Kitchen, Mahabalipuram
food_places.description: Legendary traveler favorite serving daily fresh catches seasoned with native Tamil beachside masalas.

kanchipuram.name: Kanchipuram
kanchipuram.description: The golden 'City of Thousand Temples' and sacred silk capital of India, revered for soaring Rajagopurams, ancient Pallava rock architecture, and exquisite handwoven pure mulberry silk sarees.
food_specialties: Authentic Kanchipuram Kovil Idli (steamed in bauhinia leaves with ginger & pepper)

pois.name: Ekambareswarar Temple (Earth Stalam)
pois.description: One of the five Pancha Bhoota Sthalams representing Earth (Prithvi Lingam), boasting a colossal 59-meter 11-tier gopuram and a sacred 3,500-year-old four-branched mango tree.

pois.name: Kailasanathar Temple, Kanchipuram
pois.description: The oldest surviving sandstone temple structure in Kanchipuram built in 700 CE by Pallava King Rajasimha, lined with 58 small shrines displaying delicate stone carvings.

hotels.name: Sri Krishna Grand Residency Kanchipuram
hotels.description: Modern budget hotel centrally located near silk weaving handloom centers and Ekambareswarar Temple.

food_places.name: Sri Saravana Bhavan Kanchi Temple View
food_places.description: Renowned for serving authentic spiced Kanchipuram idlis steamed inside fragrant leaf cups.

thiruvallur.name: Thiruvallur
thiruvallur.description: Famed for the grand Sri Veeraraghava Swamy temple, Poondi reservoir wetlands, and ecological coastal Pulicat lagoon sanctuaries.

pois.name: Sri Veeraraghava Swamy Temple
pois.description: Ancient Divya Desam shrine dedicated to Lord Vishnu in reclining posture, famed for Hruthtapanasini holy water tank.

pois.name: Poondi Reservoir & Nature Park
pois.description: Scenic water reservoir (Sathyamurthy Sagar) on the Kosasthalaiyar river surrounded by acacia woodlands and migratory water bird spots.

hotels.name: Golden Park Inn Thiruvallur
hotels.description: Clean, hospitable accommodation walking distance to the historic temple and railway transit.

food_places.name: Sri Balaji Vegetarian Mess, Thiruvallur
food_places.description: Beloved local tiffin canteen famous for crispy vadas and traditional banana leaf meals.

vellore.name: Vellore
vellore.description: Historic fortress city anchored by the massive 16th-century granite Vellore Fort, Jalakanteswarar temple, and Sripuram golden temple.
food_specialties: Vellore Brinjal Khatta (Spicy Tangy Baingan Curry)

pois.name: 16th-Century Vellore Fort & Jalakanteswarar Temple
pois.description: Massive granite stone fort surrounded by a wide water moat, enclosing the Vijayanagara-style Jalakanteswarar temple and Tipu Sultan's royal quarters.

pois.name: Sripuram Golden Temple (Malaikodi)
pois.description: Spiritual sanctuary covered with over 1,500 kilograms of pure gold foil set within a lush star-shaped green walkway and landscaped water fountains.

hotels.name: GRT Grand Days Vellore
hotels.description: Premium comfort hotel positioned close to Vellore Fort and highway connecting Chennai & Bengaluru.

food_places.name: Hotel Saravana Pure Veg Vellore
food_places.description: Popular breakfast and dinner destination offering crispy dosas and rich sambar.

ranipet.name: Ranipet
ranipet.description: Historic Nawabi heartland encompassing Arcot, famed for the historic Delhi Gate, Walajah sweet heritage, and 7th-century Mahendravadi rock-cut cave shrines.

pois.name: Delhi Gate & Arcot Fort Heritage Enclave
pois.description: Red-brick gateway standing as the sole remnant of the historic Siege of Arcot (1751) fought by Robert Clive and the Nawab of the Carnatic.

hotels.name: Ranipet Highway Residency
hotels.description: Convenient transit basecamp situated on the Chennai-Bengaluru arterial route.

food_places.name: Star Biryani & Halwa Stall, Arcot
food_places.description: Celebrated since the Nawabi era for aromatic short-grain mutton biryani cooked over wood fires.

tirupattur.name: Tirupattur
tirupattur.description: Highland district featuring the pristine Yelagiri hill station, 14 hairpin bend scenic ghat road, cascading Jalagamparai waterfalls, and world-renowned Ambur biryani culinary culture.
food_specialties: Javadi Millet Roti with Nattu Kozhi Curry

pois.name: Yelagiri Hills Nature Park & Punganoor Lake
pois.description: Tranquil hill station lake surrounded by gardens, musical fountains, artificial cascades, and pedal boat tours at 1,110m elevation.

pois.name: Swamimalai Hill Peak Trek, Yelagiri
pois.description: Trek to the highest point in Yelagiri Hills (4,338 ft) shaped like a cake, offering sweeping valley panoramas over the Eastern Ghats.

hotels.name: Yelagiri Hills Cloud Nine Resort
hotels.description: Serene hillside retreat nestled in fruit orchards, featuring cool mountain breezes and campfire evenings.

food_places.name: Ambur Star Biryani Since 1890
food_places.description: World-famous progenitor of Ambur-style biryani, slow-dum cooked with seeraga samba rice and marinated curd-based mutton.

tiruvannamalai.name: Tiruvannamalai
tiruvannamalai.description: Spiritual powerhouse of South India, sacred home of Mount Arunachala representing the cosmic fire element (Agni Stalam), Sri Ramanasramam, and the grand Annamalaiyar temple complex.

pois.name: Arulmigu Arunachaleswarar Temple (Agni Stalam)
pois.description: One of India's largest Shaivite temple complexes covering 25 acres at the foot of Arunachala Hill, featuring four soaring gopurams including the 66-meter Raja Gopuram.

pois.name: Sacred Arunachala Girivalam Path & 8 Lingams
pois.description: 14-kilometer sacred circumambulation barefoot route around holy Mount Arunachala passing eight sacred cardinal lingam shrines.

hotels.name: Arunachala Ramana Heritage Inn
hotels.description: Serene retreat with direct unobstructed views of the sacred Arunachala hill.

food_places.name: Sri Akshaya Bhavan Pure Veg, Tiruvannamalai
food_places.description: Clean, uplifting sattvic eatery serving traditional South Indian meals without garlic or onion.

villupuram.name: Villupuram
villupuram.description: Historic heart of the impregnable Gingee Fort ('Troy of the East'), rocky boulder citadels, and ancient Jain rock-cut caverns.

pois.name: Gingee Fort ('Troy of the East' - Rajagiri Citadel)
pois.description: Spectacular 13th-century mountain citadel atop a 240-meter sheer granite cliff with a wooden drawbridge, 7-story Kalyana Mahal, and granaries.

hotels.name: Gingee Fort View Residency
hotels.description: Convenient basecamp located within sight of the dramatic Rajagiri citadel.

food_places.name: Annapoorna Veg Villupuram Junction
food_places.description: Popular junction dining hall serving fresh steamed tiffins and piping hot filter coffee.

kallakurichi.name: Kallakurichi
kallakurichi.description: Lush highland eco-tourism sanctuary anchored by the Kalvarayan Hills, roaring Megam falls, Gomukhi dam reservoir, and tribal spice plantations.

pois.name: Megam Falls & Periyar Falls, Kalvarayan Hills
pois.description: Pristine tiered mountain cascades tumbling down forested granite gorges in the Kalvarayan hill range.

hotels.name: Kalvarayan Mist Homestay
hotels.description: Tranquil hillside stay surrounded by pepper vines and fruit orchards.

food_places.name: Sri Lakshmi Mess Kallakurichi
food_places.description: Authentic rustic country mess renowned for wholesome stone-ground gravies.

cuddalore.name: Cuddalore
cuddalore.description: Coastal heritage district home to the world's second-largest mangrove forest at Pichavaram, historic Silver Beach, and maritime estuaries.

pois.name: Pichavaram Mangrove Forest & Boating
pois.description: World's second largest mangrove ecosystem covering 1,100 hectares with 4,400 interconnected water channels navigated by rowboats under root canopies.

pois.name: Silver Beach Devanampattinam
pois.description: Unspoiled 57-km coastal sand stretch on the Coromandel Coast with historic Fort St. David ruins nearby.

hotels.name: Mangrove Eco Resort Pichavaram
hotels.address: Pichavaram Boat Jetty Road, Chidambaram Taluk
hotels.description: Charming eco-resort situated right at the entrance of the Pichavaram mangrove waterways.

food_places.name: Coastal Catch Seafood Chidambaram / Cuddalore
food_places.description: Celebrated for fresh estuarine fish and crab seasoned with black peppercorns and fennel.

salem.name: Salem
salem.description: Historic mango and steel capital nestled beneath the Shevaroy Hills, gateway to the tranquil Yercaud hill resort via 20 hairpin bends, and Mettur Dam reservoir.

pois.name: Yercaud Emerald Lake & Lady's Seat
pois.description: 'Jewel of the South' lake situated at 1,515m elevation surrounded by cloud-kissed coffee plantations, orange groves, and cliffside telescope overlooks.

pois.name: Kiliyur Waterfalls, Yercaud
pois.description: 300-foot waterfall dropping into the Servaroyan valley, reached via a rewarding forested stairway trek.

pois.name: Mettur Dam & Stanley Reservoir Park
pois.description: One of India's oldest multi-purpose masonry dams constructed in 1934 across the River Cauvery, featuring expansive landscaped parks and fish stalls.

hotels.name: The Grand Estancia Salem
hotels.description: Sophisticated hotel offering easy access to Salem junction and the Yercaud ghat road entrance.

food_places.name: Salem Famous Thattu Vadai Settu Corner
food_places.description: Salem's iconic evening street snack: two crispy spiced rice discs sandwiched with grated beetroot, carrots, and secret tangy green sauce.

namakkal.name: Namakkal
namakkal.description: Highland district crowned by the mythic Kolli Hills (famed for 70 hair-raising hairpin bends), the 300-ft Agaya Gangai waterfall, and the 18-ft monolithic Anjaneyar statue.
food_specialties: Namakkal Nattu Kozhi (Country Chicken) Pepper Fry
Ragi Roti with Spicy Country Gravy

pois.name: Kolli Hills & Arapaleeswarar Temple (70 Hairpin Bends)
pois.description: Untouched Eastern Ghats mountain haven reached by an exhilarating 70 continuous hairpin road, famed for medicinal herbs and 1000-year-old Shiva temple.

pois.name: Agaya Gangai 300-Ft Waterfalls, Kolli Hills
pois.description: Roaring 300-foot waterfall cascading into a deep valley surrounded by cliffs, accessed via descending and climbing 1,050 stone steps.

pois.name: Namakkal Fort & 18-Ft Monolithic Anjaneyar Temple
pois.description: Massive single-stone 18-foot open-air idol of Lord Hanuman standing eye-to-eye with Lord Narasimha in Namakkal single rock fort.

hotels.name: Kolli Hills Green Valley Villa
hotels.description: Quiet hilltop cottages surrounded by medicinal trees, offering cool climate and campfire evenings.

food_places.name: Namakkal Nattu Kozhi Mess Since 1974
food_places.description: Celebrated across Tamil Nadu for free-range country chicken pan-fried in stone-ground black pepper and pure gingelly oil.

dharmapuri.name: Dharmapuri
dharmapuri.description: Famed for Hogenakkal Falls ('Niagara of India'), swirling coracle river voyages on the Cauvery gorge, therapeutic medicinal herbal river waters, and the sacred Theerthamalai shrine.
food_specialties: Dharmapuri Ragi Mudde with Naatu Kozhi Gravy
Crispy Medu Vadai with Coconut Chutney

pois.name: Hogenakkal Falls & Coracle Boat Rides ('Niagara of India')
pois.description: Spectacular cascade where the Cauvery river splits into myriad roaring plumes cutting through ancient carbonatite rocks, celebrated for traditional round coracle boat navigation.

hotels.name: Hogenakkal River View Resort
hotels.description: Comfortable riverside stay located five minutes from the main boat jetty.

food_places.name: Kaveri River Fish & Ragi Mess, Hogenakkal
food_places.description: Authentic riverside shacks where freshly caught river fish is marinated in fiery hand-ground spices and fried right before you.

krishnagiri.name: Krishnagiri
krishnagiri.description: Known as the mango bowl of Tamil Nadu, featuring Krishnagiri Dam reservoir gardens, historic Syed Basha mountain fort, and the industrial hub of Hosur.

pois.name: Krishnagiri Dam & Reservoir Park
pois.description: Scenic dam constructed across the Thenpennai river flanked by rugged granite hills, extensive green lawns, and flower beds.

hotels.name: Daisy Sky Inn Krishnagiri
hotels.description: Comfortable highway hotel for travelers touring the Kongu gateway.

food_places.name: Highway Mango Kitchen Krishnagiri
food_places.description: Popular stopover featuring Kongu style gravies and seasonal mango delicacies.

erode.name: Erode
erode.description: The turmeric capital of India ('Yellow City'), renowned for Bhavani Kooduthurai Triveni Sangam, Kodiveri waterfall dam, and authentic Pallipalayam chicken.

pois.name: Bhavani Kooduthurai (Triveni Sangam of TN)
pois.description: Sacred confluence where Cauvery, Bhavani, and the mystic subterranean Amutha rivers merge, watched over by the ancient Sangameswarar Temple.

pois.name: Kodiveri Dam Waterfalls & Park
pois.description: Historic stone weir built across the Bhavani River where cascading sheets of water provide refreshing river bathing beneath shady tamarind groves.

hotels.name: Hotel Turmeric Erode
hotels.description: Modern comfortable business and tourist hotel in the heart of Erode.

food_places.name: Pallipalayam Nattu Kozhi Mess, Erode
specialties: Signature Pallipalayam Chicken (cooked with garlic & red chillies)
food_places.description: The birthplace of Pallipalayam chicken—tender meat simmered without water using abundant shallots, garlic cloves, and broken dry red chillies.

tiruppur.name: Tiruppur
tiruppur.description: Textile powerhouse of South India ('Knitwear Capital'), home to the scenic Thirumoorthy Hills, Amaravathi crocodile reserve, and authentic Arisi Paruppu Sadam.
food_specialties: Arisi Paruppu Sadam (classic Kongu one-pot lentil rice with ghee)

pois.name: Thirumoorthy Hills, Dam & Panjalinga Waterfalls
pois.description: Scenic Western Ghats foothills harboring the Amanalingeswarar Temple (Trinity of Shiva, Vishnu & Brahma) and the mountain cascade of Panjalinga Falls.

hotels.name: Poppys Tower Tiruppur
hotels.description: Contemporary hotel with excellent connectivity to Avinashi temple and Kongu highway.

food_places.name: Kongu Kitchen Arisi Paruppu Mess, Tiruppur
specialties: Authentic Arisi Paruppu Sadam with Ghee
food_places.description: Specializing in the quintessential Kongu comfort meal of turmeric-tinted rice and toor dal tempered with mustard, shallots, and fresh ghee.

coimbatore.name: Coimbatore
coimbatore.description: The textile and engineering powerhouse 'Manchester of South India', gateway to the Nilgiris, blessed with Siruvani sweet water, Adiyogi Shiva, and Annapoorna cuisine.

pois.name: 112-Ft Adiyogi Shiva & Isha Yoga Center
pois.description: Guinness World Record 112-foot steel bust of Adiyogi Shiva symbolizing the 112 ways to reach self-transformation, set against the dramatic Velliangiri Foothills.

pois.name: Marudhamalai Hilltop Murugan Temple
pois.description: 12th-century hill shrine set amid Western Ghats medicinal shola flora, considered the 7th Padaiveedu of Lord Murugan.

pois.name: Siruvani Waterfalls & Dam (World's 2nd Sweetest Water)
pois.description: Picturesque forest waterfall renowned worldwide for mineral-rich water rated the second sweetest on Earth, nestled within the dense Anaikatti forest reserve.

hotels.name: Gokulam Park Coimbatore
hotels.description: Well-appointed upscale hotel offering rapid transit to the Nilgiri foothills and city center.

food_places.name: Sree Annapoorna Sree Gowrishankar, Coimbatore
food_places.description: The gold standard of Tamil vegetarian dining, famed for its proprietary secret sambar recipe and world-class fresh chicory-tinted filter coffee.

nilgiris.name: Nilgiris
nilgiris.description: The 'Blue Mountains' crowned by Doddabetta Peak (2,637 m), UNESCO mountain steam railway, rolling emerald tea estates, Toda tribal culture, and refreshing colonial hill sanctuaries.
food_specialties: Authentic Ooty Varkey (crisp flaky puff pastry)

pois.name: Doddabetta Peak & Telescope House, Ooty
pois.description: Highest mountain in the Nilgiri Hills (2,637 m / 8,652 ft) offering panoramic 360-degree views across misty shola forests, valleys, and distant plains.

pois.name: Pykara Waterfalls & Boating Reservoir
pois.description: Sacred Toda river tumbling over two tiers of granite ledges into a tranquil mountain reservoir equipped with TTDC speedboats.

pois.name: Government Botanical Garden & Rose Garden, Ooty
pois.description: Colonial garden founded in 1848 terraced across 55 acres, showcasing over 1,000 exotic floral species and a 20-million-year-old fossilized tree trunk.

pois.name: UNESCO Nilgiri Mountain Railway (Ooty - Coonoor Toy Train)
pois.description: UNESCO World Heritage meter-gauge rack-and-pinion steam railway traversing 16 tunnels, 250 bridges, and deep river ravines through cloud-capped tea valleys.

hotels.name: Nilgiri Mist Valley Homestay, Ooty
hotels.description: Serene colonial-style cottage bordered by eucalyptus groves, offering home-cooked Nilgiri meals and fireplace warmth.

food_places.name: Westly's Nilgiri Varkey & Tea Room, Ooty
specialties: Crisp Flaky Ooty Varkey (straight from wood-fired oven)
food_places.description: The quintessential Ooty experience: dipping warm, flaky varkey pastry into fresh Nilgiri orthodox tea while watching mountain mist roll over the peaks.

karur.name: Karur
karur.description: Historic Chera dynasty capital on the banks of River Amaravathi, celebrated for the 2000-year-old Pasupatheeswarar temple, textile handlooms, and Mayanur barrage.

pois.name: Sri Pasupatheeswarar Ancient Chola Temple
pois.description: Ancient Shiva shrine built by the Cholas with inscriptions dating back to 1st century BCE, featuring a 5-foot swayambhu lingam with hoof marks.

hotels.name: The Residency Karur
hotels.description: Reliable, well-maintained hotel for tourists and business travelers.

food_places.name: Sree Shanthi Mess Karur
food_places.description: Wholesome Kongu vegetarian and non-vegetarian fare served on fresh plantain leaves.

tiruchirappalli.name: Tiruchirappalli
tiruchirappalli.description: Historic heart of Tamil Nadu crowned by Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple at Srirangam (world's largest functioning temple complex), Rockfort Ucchi Pillayar temple, and Grand Anicut.

pois.name: Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple, Srirangam
pois.description: Massive 156-acre river-island temple complex with 21 grand gopurams including the 73-meter Rajagopuram, 39 pavilions, and 50 sub-shrines.

pois.name: Rockfort Ucchi Pillayar Temple (437 Stone Steps)
pois.description: Historic fortress perched atop an 83-meter ancient monolithic rock (older than the Himalayas at 3.8 billion years), climbing 437 steps to an eagle-eye panoramic view.

pois.name: Kallanai Dam (Grand Anicut Built 2nd Century CE)
pois.description: World's fourth-oldest water-diversion dam still in operational use, built by King Karikala Chola across the unharnessed Cauvery river.

hotels.name: Grand Gardenia Trichy Central
hotels.description: Centrally placed hotel offering quick access to Rockfort, Srirangam island, and the airport.

food_places.name: Sri Sangeethas Veg Central, Trichy
food_places.description: Legendary Trichy dining brand serving banana leaf vegetarian meals and authentic GI-tagged Manapparai murukku.

thanjavur.name: Thanjavur
thanjavur.description: The glorious cradle of Tamil classical art, music, and bronze casting, anchored by the UNESCO World Heritage Brihadisvara Temple ('Big Temple') and Kumbakonam temples.

pois.name: Brihadisvara Temple (UNESCO 'Big Temple')
pois.description: Architectural marvel consecrated in 1010 CE by King Raja Raja Chola I, featuring a 66-meter granite vimana crowned with an 80-tonne monolithic cupola that casts no midday shadow.

pois.name: Thanjavur Maratha Royal Palace & Saraswathi Mahal Library
pois.description: 16th-century palace complex of the Nayak and Maratha rulers housing world-famous Chola bronzes and the Saraswathi Mahal Library holding 60,000 ancient palm-leaf manuscripts.

hotels.name: Hotel Gnanam Thanjavur
hotels.description: Highly regarded heritage city stay walking distance to the Big Temple and royal palace.

food_places.name: Murali's Kumbakonam Degree Coffee & Mess, Thanjavur
specialties: Authentic Cow Milk Degree Filter Kaapi
food_places.description: Pure cow-milk degree coffee frothed into brass dabarah sets, accompanying hot spongy idlis served with spicy fennel Kadappa.

ariyalur.name: Ariyalur
ariyalur.description: Imperial Chola heartland harboring the UNESCO World Heritage Brihadisvara temple at Gangaikonda Cholapuram built by King Rajendra Chola I, and prehistoric Cretaceous fossil beds.
food_specialties: Crispy Medu Vadai with Coconut Chutney

pois.name: Gangaikonda Cholapuram (UNESCO Brihadisvara Temple)
pois.description: UNESCO World Heritage temple constructed in 1035 CE by Emperor Rajendra Chola I to commemorate his victorious military expedition to the sacred River Ganges.

hotels.name: Chola Heritage Regency Ariyalur
hotels.description: Comfortable stay for history buffs exploring Chola monuments and fossil grounds.

food_places.name: Sri Venkateshwara Mess Jayankondam
specialties: Banana Leaf Meals with Kollidam Fish
food_places.description: Home-style country mess serving authentic regional fish curries and piping hot rasam.

perambalur.name: Perambalur
perambalur.description: Historic crossroads featuring the 17th-century Ranjankudi Nayaka fort, Chettikulam temple, and Pachamalai hills eco-trails.

pois.name: Ranjankudi Fort (17th-Century Nayaka Stronghold)
pois.description: Massive stone fortress with three tiers of stone battlements that witnessed the Battle of Valikondah in 1751 during the Carnatic Wars.

hotels.name: Maya Hotel Perambalur
hotels.description: Clean, practical transit basecamp on the Trichy-Chennai national highway.

food_places.name: Annapoorna Grand Highway Perambalur
food_places.description: Reliable highway restaurant providing clean, wholesome meals and quick service.

pudukkottai.name: Pudukkottai
pudukkottai.description: Historic princely state famed for 2nd-century BCE Sittanavasal rock-cut Jain murals, Thirumayam boulder fort, and grand Avudaiyarkoil shrine.

pois.name: Sittanavasal 2nd-Century BCE Jain Cave & Fresco Murals
pois.description: Ancient monolithic rock-cut cave containing exquisite natural vegetable-dye fresco paintings of lotus tanks and dancing apsaras, rivaling Ajanta caves.

pois.name: Thirumayam Rock-Cut Fort & Perumal Cave
pois.description: Historic 40-acre fortress built atop a granite boulder by King Sethupathi of Ramanathapuram, with rock-cut shrines to Lord Vishnu and Lord Shiva.

hotels.name: Chidambara Vilas Heritage Gateway
hotels.description: Authentic architectural stay with antique woodwork and royal princely decor.

food_places.name: Royal Mess Pudukkottai
food_places.description: Famed for flaky shredded egg parotta tossed on hot iron griddles with roasted shallots.

dindigul.name: Dindigul
dindigul.description: Renowned for the misty 'Princess of Hill Stations' Kodaikanal (at 2,133 m elevation), historic Dindigul Rock Fort, and legendary Seeraga Samba Biryani.
food_specialties: Dindigul Thalappakatti Seeraga Samba Mutton Biryani

pois.name: Kodaikanal Star-Shaped Lake & Coaker's Walk
pois.description: Iconic artificial star-shaped lake created in 1863 set amidst pine hills, flanked by Coaker's Walk—a 1-km cliffside pedestrian promenade over misty valleys.

pois.name: Pillar Rocks & Guna Caves (Devil's Kitchen)
pois.description: Three vertical granite rock pillars standing 122 meters high jutting into cloud-filled canyons, adjacent to ancient moss-draped deep caves.

pois.name: Silver Cascade Falls, Kodaikanal Ghat
pois.description: Sparkling 55-meter waterfall tumbling over steep rocks directly alongside the main Kodaikanal-Batlagundu ghat road.

hotels.name: Kodai Pine Haven Inn, Kodaikanal
hotels.description: Budget lakeside stay offering quiet surroundings, cycling rentals, and rapid access to Coaker's Walk.

food_places.name: Dindigul Thalappakatti Authentic Biryani Since 1957
food_places.description: The founding birthplace of Thalappakatti biryani—fragrant short-grain Seeraga Samba rice slow-dum cooked with tender Kannivadi meat and stone-ground spices.

theni.name: Theni
theni.description: Valley of green abundance at the foot of the Western Ghats, celebrated for Suruli falls, Meghamalai Highwavys cloud forest, and lush Cumbum grape vineyards.
food_specialties: Cumbum Valley Fresh Paneer Grapes & Juice

pois.name: Suruli Waterfalls & 18 Natural Caves
pois.description: Famous two-stage waterfall mentioned in the ancient epic Silappadikaram, cascading through 18 natural rock caves with herbal-rich healing water.

pois.name: Meghamalai ('Highwavys' Cloud Mountain)
pois.description: High-altitude tea estate mountain range at 1,500m shrouded in perpetual mist, offering encounters with wild elephants and Nilgiri tahrs.

hotels.name: Cloud Mountain Homestay Meghamalai
hotels.description: Serene homestay surrounded by rolling tea bushes and cool mountain breezes.

food_places.name: Green Valley Restaurant Theni
food_places.description: Popular stopover serving farm-fresh grape juice and authentic South Tamil non-vegetarian delicacies.

madurai.name: Madurai
madurai.description: The ancient soul of Tamil culture ('Thoonga Nagaram' - City That Never Sleeps), home to the world-renowned Meenakshi Amman Temple, Thirumalai Nayakkar Palace, and iconic Jigarthanda.
food_specialties: Madurai Special Famous Jigarthanda (almond gum, nannari & cream)

pois.name: Meenakshi Amman Temple, Madurai
pois.description: Historic Dravidian masterpiece with 14 soaring gopurams adorned with thousands of colorful mythological stucco sculptures, Golden Lotus tank, and Hall of Thousand Pillars.

pois.name: Thirumalai Nayakkar Palace, Madurai
pois.description: 17th-century palace constructed by King Thirumalai Nayak, celebrated for monumental stucco arches, massive cylindrical pillars, and regal courtyard.

pois.name: Gandhi Memorial Museum, Madurai
pois.description: Housed in the historic Rani Mangammal palace, preserving Mahatma Gandhi's blood-stained dhoti from his 1948 assassination and freedom movement archives.

hotels.name: Madurai Temple View Residency
hotels.description: Comfortable budget hotel situated walking distance from Meenakshi Temple, boasting rooftop vistas of illuminated gopurams.

food_places.name: Murugan Idli Shop, Madurai
food_places.description: Legendary Madurai establishment famous across India for cloud-soft idlis slathered with spiced podi and four varieties of fresh coconut chutney.

food_places.name: Famous Jigarthanda Since 1977, Madurai
food_places.description: The quintessential royal Madurai cooler prepared with pure almond tree gum (badam pisin), nannari root syrup, condensed milk, and clotted cream.

sivaganga.name: Sivaganga
sivaganga.description: The opulent land of Chettinad, celebrated for magnificent merchant mansions with Burma teak and Belgian glass, Athangudi handmade tiles, and world-famous Chettinad cuisine.

pois.name: Chettinad Merchant Mansions of Kanadukathan
pois.description: Breathtaking 19th-century palatial residences of Nattukottai Chettiars adorned with carved Burma teak pillars, Athangudi terracotta tiles, and Belgian crystal chandeliers.

pois.name: Athangudi Handmade Terracotta Tile Studios
pois.description: Artisan village workshops crafting world-famous glazed floor tiles by hand using local soil, colored oxides, and geometric glass stencils.

hotels.name: Chettinad Heritage Courtyard Mansion, Kanadukathan
hotels.description: Authentically restored 19th-century merchant mansion featuring Italian marble, Belgian mirrors, and authentic silver-thali banquets.

food_places.name: Visalam Authentic Chettinad Kitchen, Kanadukathan
food_places.description: Home-style recipes flavored with roasted peppercorn, kalpasi (stone flower), and star anise served on fresh banana leaves.

virudhunagar.name: Virudhunagar
virudhunagar.description: Spiritual land home to the iconic Srivilliputhur Andal Temple (the 11-tier gopuram that forms the official Emblem of Tamil Nadu) and GI-tagged Srivilliputhur Palkova.

pois.name: Srivilliputhur Andal Temple (Tamil Nadu State Emblem)
pois.description: Consecrated in the 8th century, its towering 192-foot 11-tier Raja Gopuram was chosen by the government as the official emblem of Tamil Nadu.

hotels.name: Srivilliputhur Heritage Residency
hotels.description: Comfortable, clean budget hotel located near the historic Andal temple.

food_places.name: Sri Venkateswara Palkova Stall & Parotta, Srivilliputhur
food_places.description: World-famous GI-tagged sweet made strictly by slow-simmering pure cow milk with cane sugar over firewood.

ramanathapuram.name: Ramanathapuram
ramanathapuram.description: Sacred island pilgrimage gateway home to Ramanathaswamy Temple (with the longest pillared corridor in the world), Pamban sea bridge, and Dhanushkodi ghost town at Ram Setu point.

pois.name: Ramanathaswamy Temple & 22 Theerthams, Rameswaram
pois.description: One of the twelve sacred Jyotirlingas, boasting the longest pillared corridor in the world (1,212 meters) with 1,212 intricately carved sandstone pillars.

pois.name: Dhanushkodi Ghost Town & Ram Setu Point
pois.description: Eerie coastal sand spit where the Bay of Bengal meets the Indian Ocean, destroyed in the 1964 cyclone, showing church ruins and Ram Setu land's end.

pois.name: Pamban Rail & Sea Bridge
pois.description: India's first sea bridge opened in 1914, spanning 2.06 kilometers over the Indian Ocean with a double-leaf bascule section that lifts for ships.

hotels.name: Rameswaram Sea View Residency
hotels.description: Centrally positioned for coastal theertham baths and morning temple darshans with clean facilities.

food_places.name: Sri Saravana Veg & Coastal Kitchen, Rameswaram
food_places.description: Popular establishment serving clean pilgrim tiffins in the morning and spicy coastal catch curries.

thoothukudi.name: Thoothukudi
thoothukudi.description: Historic 'Pearl City' of South India, home to the sea-washed Tiruchendur Subramanya Swamy temple, Portuguese Our Lady of Snows Basilica, and famous Tuticorin macaroons.

pois.name: Thiruchendur Subramanya Swamy Temple
pois.description: Second Padaiveedu of Lord Murugan, spectacularly located right on the shoreline waves of the Gulf of Mannar with a 137-foot nine-tier gopuram.

pois.name: Our Lady of Snows Basilica, Tuticorin
pois.description: 16th-century Portuguese Roman Catholic church elevated to minor basilica status, enshrining a miraculous statue of Our Lady of Snows brought from Manila in 1555.

hotels.name: Regency Tuticorin by GRT Hotels
hotels.description: High-quality hotel offering comfortable stays and local coastal gastronomy.

food_places.name: Bell Macaroons & Alwar Parotta, Tuticorin
food_places.description: Legendary confectioners creating airy, melt-in-the-mouth conical macaroons made solely with egg whites, cashew nuts, and sugar.

tirunelveli.name: Tirunelveli
tirunelveli.description: Ancient cultural stronghold on the perennial Thamirabarani river, celebrated for the monumental Nellaiappar Temple (musical pillars), and world-famous Iruttu Kadai Halwa.
food_specialties: GI-Tagged Tirunelveli Iruttu Kadai Halwa (wheat halwa in pure ghee)

pois.name: Nellaiappar Temple & Musical Stone Pillars
pois.description: Massive 7th-century temple complex covering 14 acres dedicated to Lord Shiva and Goddess Gandhimathi, famed for cluster pillars that ring musical notes when struck.

pois.name: Manimuthar Falls & Dam Reserve
pois.description: Perennial mountain cascade tumbling into a natural pond at the foot of the Western Ghats tiger reserve.

hotels.name: Hotel Apple Tree Tirunelveli
hotels.description: Modern hotel located close to the railway junction and Nellaiappar temple.

food_places.name: Iruttu Kadai Original Halwa Since 1900, Tirunelveli
specialties: Original Warm Wheat Halwa (served on banaleaf)
food_places.description: World-famous modest shop that opens only in the evening with a single bulb, selling warm, melting wheat halwa made with pure ghee and Thamirabarani water.

tenkasi.name: Tenkasi
tenkasi.description: The 'Spa of South India' nestled at the base of the Western Ghats, famed for Courtallam's medicated waterfalls, 180-ft gopuram of Kasi Viswanathar temple, and herbal parotta.
food_specialties: Courtallam Medicated Herbal Parotta with Country Chicken

pois.name: Courtallam Main Falls & Five Falls ('Spa of South India')
pois.description: Revered natural cascades tumbling through Western Ghats medicinal herbal forests, delivering natural therapeutic baths celebrated in Tamil literature for millennia.

pois.name: Kasi Viswanathar Temple, Tenkasi
pois.description: Constructed in 1440 CE by King Parakkirama Pandian ('Kasi of the South'), featuring a 180-foot high nine-tier Rajagopuram that catches gentle mountain breezes.

hotels.name: Mount n Mist Resort Courtallam
hotels.description: Comfortable hillside resort offering quick access to Five Falls and herbal streams.

food_places.name: Border Rahmath Parotta Stall, Tenkasi / Courtallam
food_places.description: Legendary border food institution serving crispy, feather-light coin parottas soaked in aromatic pepper country chicken gravies.

kanyakumari.name: Kanyakumari
kanyakumari.description: The majestic southernmost tip of mainland India, where the Indian Ocean, Arabian Sea, and Bay of Bengal converge, home to Vivekananda Rock Memorial and 133-ft Thiruvalluvar Statue.
food_specialties: Kanyakumari Nanjil Nadu Fish Curry with Tapioca
Crispy Pazha Bajji with Coconut Chutney

pois.name: Vivekananda Rock Memorial & 133-Ft Thiruvalluvar Statue
pois.description: Iconic granite monument erected in 1970 on an offshore rock where Swami Vivekananda meditated in 1892, adjacent to the monumental 133-foot stone statue of saint-poet Thiruvalluvar.

pois.name: Triveni Sangam & Sunset / Sunrise Viewpoint
pois.description: Unique geographic point on Earth where three seas meet, celebrated for watching the sun rise and set over the same ocean waters.

pois.name: Padmanabhapuram Wooden Palace (Thuckalay)
pois.description: Magnificent 16th-century royal palace of the Travancore kings built entirely of teakwood, rosewood, and polished stone at the foot of the Veli Hills.

hotels.name: Sparsa Resort Kanyakumari
hotels.description: Eco-friendly beachfront resort offering direct views of the sunrise over the three seas.

food_places.name: Saravana Pure Veg Sunrise Point, Kanyakumari

food_places.description: Premier dining spot for catching the ocean sunrise while enjoying piping hot ghee roast dosas and fresh coconut chutneys.

nagapattinam.name: Nagapattinam
nagapattinam.description: Historic multi-faith coastal haven home to the Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health Velankanni, Nagore Dargah shrine, and Point Calimere bird sanctuary.

pois.name: Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health, Velankanni
pois.description: Gothic-style Marian minor basilica ('Lourdes of the East') welcoming millions of multi-faith pilgrims on the shores of the Bay of Bengal.

pois.description: 16th-century Sufi pilgrimage shrine with five minarets, the tallest rising 131 feet, celebrated for communal harmony and evening lamps.

hotels.description: Comfortable hotel situated walking distance from the Velankanni basilica shrine.

food_places.name: Hotel Sea Gate Dining Velankanni
food_places.description: Celebrated coastal eatery serving fresh Bay of Bengal fish, prawns, and crabs.

pois.name: Kapaleeshwarar Temple, Mylapore

pois.name: Vedanthangal Bird Sanctuary

pois.name: Ekambareswarar Temple (Earth Stalam)

pois.name: Sri Veeraraghava Swamy Temple
pois.description: Ancient Divya Desam shrine dedicated to Lord Vishnu in reclining posture, famed for Hruthtapanasini holy water tank.

pois.name: Poondi Reservoir & Nature Park

pois.name: Sripuram Golden Temple (Malaikodi)

pois.name: Delhi Gate & Arcot Fort Heritage Enclave

pois.name: Sacred Arunachala Girivalam Path & 8 Lingams

pois.name: Gingee Fort ('Troy of the East' - Rajagiri Citadel)
pois.description: Spectacular 13th-century mountain citadel atop a 240-meter sheer granite cliff with a wooden drawbridge, 7-story Kalyana Mahal, and granaries.

pois.name: Megam Falls & Periyar Falls, Kalvarayan Hills
pois.description: Pristine tiered mountain cascades tumbling down forested granite gorges in the Kalvarayan hill range.

pois.name: Pichavaram Mangrove Forest & Boating
pois.description: World's second largest mangrove ecosystem covering 1,100 hectares with 4,400 interconnected water channels navigated by rowboats under root canopies.

pois.name: Silver Beach Devanampattinam
pois.description: Unspoiled 57-km coastal sand stretch on the Coromandel Coast with historic Fort St. David ruins nearby.

pois.name: Yercaud Emerald Lake & Lady's Seat
pois.description: 'Jewel of the South' lake situated at 1,515m elevation surrounded by cloud-kissed coffee plantations, orange groves, and cliffside telescope overlooks.

pois.name: Kiliyur Waterfalls, Yercaud
pois.description: 300-foot waterfall dropping into the Servaroyan valley, reached via a rewarding forested stairway trek.

pois.name: Mettur Dam & Stanley Reservoir Park
pois.description: One of India's oldest multi-purpose masonry dams constructed in 1934 across the River Cauvery, featuring expansive landscaped parks and fish stalls.
